title: Installation Jobs Estimator Handbook: Charging Site Conditions
content:
Estimator handbook rules for the job charges that conditions found or requested at the home add to an **Installation Jobs** record.

## General basis

Conditions found or requested at the home are charged on the job, each at the method's rate, on the date the work is done.

## Rot repair

- Rot repair beyond the included footage (the method's included feet per opening times the openings on the job) is charged per linear foot.
- The rot repair charge is the method's rate per linear foot multiplied by the linear feet replaced less the included footage, never below zero feet, rounded to the cent.
- Rot repair beyond the included footage is done and charged only after the customer approves it on site with the crew lead; support never books rot repair itself.

*Worked example (hypothetical inputs):* a job of 6 openings under a method that includes 2 linear feet per opening and charges 18.00 per linear foot. The included footage is 2 feet times 6 openings, that is 12 feet. If 15 feet are replaced, 3 feet lie beyond it and the charge is 3 feet multiplied by 18.00, that is 54.00. If 10 feet are replaced, nothing lies beyond the included footage and no rot repair charge arises.

## Per-opening items

*Retired clause:* "New interior casing is charged per opening only where the method does not include it". This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis for new interior casing.

*Retired clause:* "exterior trim capping is charged per opening only where the method offers it and does not include it". This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis for exterior trim capping.

The following items remain in force as stated:

| Item | When it is charged |
|---|---|
| Stucco or mortar patching | applies to masonry openings only |
| Storm window removal | per opening affected |
| Taking down window treatments the customer left up | per opening affected |
| Work on openings above the first floor | per opening affected |

## Booking

Each charge kind is booked once per date with the openings or feet it covers: openings for a per-opening item, linear feet for rot repair.

## Points of judgement

- **Approval for rot repair.** The approval that counts is the customer's on-site approval with the crew lead; a request made to support does not book rot repair.
- **Same kind, same date.** Two separate bookings of one charge kind on one date are not made; one booking carries all the openings or feet of that kind on that date.
- **Date of the charge.** A condition found or requested at the home is charged on the date the work is done.

superseded_clauses: New interior casing is charged per opening only where the method does not include it
exterior trim capping is charged per opening only where the method offers it and does not include it
